courses.summary: 以戈壁地區露天與地下銅礦整合為案例，研究深部公用系統與乾旱水量。 五組案例問題依序建立控制體、重算數值、檢查量測與診斷失效；計算參數是公開原理下的合成教學基準，並非該礦實際產能、設計條件或操作設定。
courses.summaryEn: A Gobi open-pit/underground copper integration case examines deep utilities and arid-region water accounting. Five case investigations define boundaries, recalculate quantities, check measurements and diagnose failures. Numerical inputs are synthetic teaching benchmarks based on public principles, not the mine’s actual capacity, design conditions or operating settings.
